tasks.label: aws-step2-validate-record
tasks.command: $env:AWS_PAGER=''; $aws='C:\Progra~1\Amazon\AWSCLIV2\aws.exe'; $cert='arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:729297431161:certificate/638b27df-0a75-4eeb-9dde-686606b47fa7'; $zone='Z07854089RH5Y6GKFWIX'; $desc = & $aws acm describe-certificate --region us-east-1 --certificate-arn $cert --output json --no-cli-pager | ConvertFrom-Json; $rr = $desc.Certificate.DomainValidationOptions[0].ResourceRecord; if (-not $rr) { throw 'No validation ResourceRecord yet'; }; $file = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'acm-validation-upsert.json'; @"{`n  ""Comment"": ""ACM validation"",`n  ""Changes"": [`n    {`n      ""Action"": ""UPSERT"",`n      ""ResourceRecordSet"": {`n        ""Name"": ""$($rr.Name)"",`n        ""Type"": ""$($rr.Type)"",`n        ""TTL"": 300,`n        ""ResourceRecords"": [{ ""Value"": ""$($rr.Value)"" }]`n      }`n    }`n  ]`n}"@ | Set-Content $file -NoNewline; & $aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id $zone --change-batch file://$file --no-cli-pager; & $aws acm describe-certificate --region us-east-1 --certificate-arn $cert --query "Certificate.DomainValidationOptions[0].ValidationStatus" --output text --no-cli-pager
